text:
Noah (sales): Quick assist: AP-SG POC tomorrow morning. Customer pinned model "redwood-legacy-xl" in their requests and are getting MODEL_NOT_FOUND from ap-sg then a bunch of 429s. Need a fast unblock, short dedicated trial pricing for 14 days, and security answers for compliance. Logs below.

Iris (se): Share the raw payload and the exact error lines. Also ask if they used model name or manifest id.

Noah (sales): They used literal name: "model: \"redwood-legacy-xl\"". Proxy logs (redacted):
[2026-10-05T02:11:07Z] req=ff77a model=redwood-legacy-xl region=ap-sg status=404 code=MODEL_NOT_FOUND msg="variant not staged"
[2026-10-05T02:11:09Z] req=ff77b model=redwood-legacy-xl region=ap-sg status=429 code=RATE_LIMIT msg="no fallback configured"
They retried and hit 429s repeatedly. Their compliance team also asked about KMS, SOC2, and log residency.

Jin (infra): Most likely the exact artifact isn't pushed to ap-sg. Quick options:
- Enable account-level routing rule to map pinned name -> local compatible variant (e.g., redwood-legacy-xl-quant)
- Provision a small Dedicated pool in ap-sg for the trial (2 GPUs for 14d)
Need manifest id if the customer insists on the exact artifact. Alias mapping is fastest.

Hiro (security): Hosted mode: we can provide SOC2 docs and KMS integration details. If they require logs to never leave APAC, recommend Dedicated in-region. For the trial we can append a Rider limiting log egress.

Iris (se): Immediate workaround: if customer consents, we can enable a routing alias that routes requests for "redwood-legacy-xl" -> "redwood-legacy-xl-quant" in ap-sg, and they can set header `x-region-preference: ap-sg` to prefer regional routing. Example snippet to test:
POST /v1/generate
Headers: Authorization: Bearer <key> ; x-region-preference: ap-sg
Body: {"model":"redwood-legacy-xl","input":"hello"}

Infra-bot: Deployment catalog check:
- redwood-legacy-xl: manifest M-c3d2 deployed: us-east, eu-west
- redwood-legacy-xl-quant: manifest M-c3d2-q deployed: ap-sg (replicas: 3)
- redwood-legacy-xl-compat: manifest M-c3d2-c deployed: ap-sg (replicas:1)

Jin (infra): Confirmed. So alias mapping to the quant variant will unblock. Manifest push to ap-sg would take ~24-48h.

Noah (sales): Customer contact: sam.park@exampleglobal.com. They prefer hosted but will accept fallback for the POC if we note differences. Need ballpark price for 2 x A100-eq for 14 days and activation time.

Deploy-bot: Created INF-4599 "AP-SG POC: alias routing + trial quote" assigned to infra, se, security. Link: https://internal.redwood/INF-4599

Jin (infra): Infra cost rough: $9k-$12k for 2x A100-equivalent for 14 days. Recommend quoting $17k including ops and monitoring. Dedicated activation ~24-48h; alias mapping ~1hr.

Hiro (security): I'll prepare a 1-page security FAQ: KMS integration steps, SOC2 link, and suggested contract language for regional logs for the trial.

Iris (se): Action items:
- Noah: get explicit written consent from the customer to accept fallback variant (note quality/latency differences)
- Jin: standby to apply alias routing once consent received (ETA 60-90m)
- Jin: open manifest push ticket if customer wants exact artifact (longer lead time)
- Hiro: send security FAQ to Noah and customer
- Billing: prepare 14-day trial quote for 2x A100-eq

Noah (sales): I pinged Sam. Park; he replied OK to try the quant variant for the POC if we put the note in writing. Please flip the alias.

Jin (infra): Applying alias now.

Infra-bot: Alias applied for acct-221: pinned=redwood-legacy-xl -> redwood-legacy-xl-quant in ap-sg.

Jin (infra): Quick verification: test requests now returning 200; some higher tail latency observed on long sequences. Monitoring closely for 429s.

Iris (se): Good. Noah, send the security FAQ and the quote once Billing finalizes. Keep the customer informed about the manifest push timeline if they later require exact parity.

Noah (sales): Will do. Closing loop with Sam. Thanks team.
